# Clervo

> Clervo is outcome infrastructure for agents: Find, Understand, Act.

Current verified status:

- Developer distribution: public TypeScript, MCP, and Python packages are registry-verified
- Customer API: public Search preview at https://api.clervo.dev
- Frozen release candidate: clervo-private-core-2026-08-02.2
- Frozen interface hash: sha256:1b32a86f5725499f90d3e2f167f4432563f67bac477a3ca0e552f0958bf26622
- Six product cores: privately qualified and compatibility-frozen
- Public lifecycle: raw cited Search and bounded paid AI chat are callable; synthesized Search, AI media, Secure Sandbox, RPC, Prediction, and Crypto Intelligence are unavailable
- Projected operation IDs: search.web, search.answer, ai.chat
- Public API callable: yes
- x402 public payment: available for search.web at a maximum charge of 0.006 USDC and for ai.chat through an exact request-derived maximum-charge quote on Base
- x402 private proof: one owner-funded useful result settled and replayed without a second charge
- Commercial proof: no customer revenue or demand claimed
- Public price: search.web maximum charge is 0.006 USDC; search.answer has no public offer
- First Revenue Release ready: no
- llms.txt is a documentation map, not a search or AI ranking claim

- [Pricing state](/pricing.json): public-offer boundary, private proof amount, and fixture amounts.

- [Discovery document](/.well-known/clervo.json): release-candidate binding and distribution status.
- [JSON Schemas](/schemas/2026-07-29.1/): projected public-wire contracts.

## Secure Sandbox preview

- `POST /v1/sandbox/execute`: fixed maximum charge 0.120000 USDC on Base for one bounded Node.js gVisor execution.
- The public operation is one-shot, no-network, resource-capped, receipt-bearing, and replay-safe. Sessions and artifact retrieval remain unavailable.

## Observed lifecycle state and proof level

Probed from the deployed system at 2026-08-06T17:01:41.422Z. Lifecycle state is what the runtime serves now. Proof level is what has actually been demonstrated; `quote_observed_unpaid` means a price and a valid payment challenge were returned and nothing more.

| Product | Lifecycle state | Proof level |
|---|---|---|
| AI | live | quote_observed_unpaid |
| Crypto Intelligence | unavailable (commercial_rights_blocked) | none |
| Prediction Intelligence | unavailable (commercial_rights_blocked) | none |
| Multi-chain RPC | unavailable (commercial_rights_blocked) | none |
| Secure Sandbox | live | quote_observed_unpaid |
| Research | live | quote_observed_unpaid |

## First call

No account, no API key, no wallet, no idempotency key:

```bash
curl -sS https://api.clervo.dev/v1/search/free \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"what is the x402 payment protocol","maxResults":3,"synthesize":false}'
```

The free sample accepts a request with no `idempotency-key` header. The server generates one and returns it in the `idempotency-key` response header; send that value back to replay the same operation without a second execution.

Paid requests go to `POST https://api.clervo.dev/v1/search/paid`, which returns a 402 carrying the exact maximum charge before anything executes.

- [Agent skill](/skill.md): when to use Clervo and how to make the first call.
- [Agent reference](/agent.md): identity, observed state, idempotency contract, and boundaries.

## Command line

One install, and a real result before a wallet exists:

```bash
npx @clervo/router search "who is shipping x402 in production"
```

No account, no API key, no wallet, no funding. The free path above is what that command calls.

Paid use is opt-in and comes later, in this order:

```bash
clervo catalog                      # what is being served right now
clervo quote search.web "<query>"   # the exact price, without paying it
clervo wallet create                # a dedicated wallet, only when you want a paid product
clervo wallet address               # fund it with USDC on Base mainnet
clervo run search.web "<query>"     # pay for one call, with the price shown first
clervo replay <key>                 # the same result again, never a second charge
clervo doctor                       # check the machine end to end
```

`clervo wallet create` never overwrites an existing wallet, and `clervo wallet restore` refuses if the wallet it would replace holds a balance. Payment is a signed USDC authorization on Base, so no gas is paid from that wallet. If a call fails after the authorization was sent, the settlement is unknown: the client records it, refuses to spend again, and resolves it with `clervo reconcile`.

## Agent discovery

- [`GET https://api.clervo.dev/v1/models`](/models.json): every catalogued AI route with its exact model identity, lifecycle state, proof level, and observed price. OpenAI list shape.
- [`GET https://api.clervo.dev/.well-known/x402`](/.well-known/x402.json): the x402 v2 payment manifest. Each item carries the exact quote the resource returns.
- `GET https://api.clervo.dev/llms.txt`: this document, served from the API host as well as the site.

Model list: 21 catalogued routes, 18 sellable. Payment manifest: 3 paid resources.
